name: manual_f4798b
claim: Blanket output masking can hide the property under test: masking every address turned loopback listeners into an apparent LAN exposure and produced a false security finding. Mask by category (loopback, non-loopback) instead of a generic placeholder, re-check a finding against categorised output before reporting it, and retract it openly if it was wrong.

decisions.notes: A plain portal listener was reported as exposed on the LAN address; it listened on loopback only. The mask erased the difference.

rationale: A plain portal listener was reported as exposed on the LAN address; it listened on loopback only. The mask erased the difference.
